audit.why: EVEN, 5.5/10 matches a lane that starts Nami's poke war and flips to Rakan once his W-E dash combo and R charm come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' with no real side named, while content win[0-6] (Nami,Nami,Nami,Rakan,Rakan,Rakan,Nami) and the packet levelChart both give a specific side for every row, and phases[3-5].why described neither side's advantage clearly.
audit.why: A flat 'Skill' chart hides the actual level-by-level swing that the content layer and packet already agree on, and phases[3-5].why did not name why Rakan takes over at 4-6.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-2].side and phases[6].side to Nami, phases[3-5].side to Rakan (all match existing win[N], no win edits needed), and rewrote phases[3-5].why to state Rakan's W-E dash combo, R charm-engage, and mobility-item advantage explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Rakan's Fey Feathers (P) and Battle Dance (E) shield absorbs burst, or that Gleaming Quill (Q) sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing to shut down.
audit.why: Both are flagged in missingInteractions as applicable to this matchup and were absent from the prose.
audit.corrected: Added a Don'ts note on baiting his shield before committing burst, and named real cooldown numbers for Grand Entrance/Aqua Prison in breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Tide the margins: bounce the trades, bubble the answers, and bank the tempo passive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 flip: his W into E dash combo starts reaching your ADC before you can bubble it.

edits.before: Tidal Wave online — engages arrive on a wave and disengages leave on one.
edits.after: The Quickness (R) adds a charm engage and roam threat your kit can't match.

edits.before: First item: the bounce chunks and the bubble converts every gank.
edits.after: First item: his mobility outslips your bubble on every engage.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: Bubble the moment Grand Entrance (W) is thrown — its 14-10s cooldown is the window to punish the whiff hard.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Bursting into his shield — Fey Feathers/Battle Dance absorb it, so bait the shield out first.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep Q Aqua Prison banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Rakan Grand Entrance (W): 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown — the leap knockup starts every play; track him in fog, the E extends it. - Your Q Aqua Prison: 12-8s, bank it for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
